scene.prompt: Eye-level studio product photograph in 4:5 portrait aspect ratio on a seamless, pure solid white (#FFFFFF) background with a cutout-on-ground framing and no visible horizon or picture edge. Positioned in the left third of the frame (x=0% to 36%, y=10% to 82.5%), a glossy crimson red patent-leather high-heeled stiletto pump (#C90E13, deep shadow #8E0508) enters from the left edge (cropped between y=41% and 52.5%) angled sharply upward, its slender red stiletto heel morphing seamlessly into a glossy three-pronged red metal pitchfork. The three red prongs dip directly into the top of a small, tall, round chocolate fudge cake grounded at the lower left (x=14.5% to 35%, y=55.5% to 82.5%), coated in thick, rich glossy chocolate-caramel ganache overflowing the rim with a heavy, lustrous drip running down the right side of the cake onto the white surface. Shot with a normal-to-short-telephoto lens and deep focus keeping the patent leather, red trident prongs, and moist cake ganache tack-sharp. Bright, soft studio lighting from the upper right casts crisp white specular highlights along the red shoe and glossy ganache, with a soft diffused contact shadow falling to the bottom-left of the cake. Real materials, natural photographic realism, no plastic AI sheen. Keep the rest of the frame pure, completely uncluttered flat white (#FFFFFF) negative space for typography and logo overlays at x=72%–90.5% y=7.5%–12%, x=46%–90.5% y=30.5%–55.5%, and x=9.5%–90.5% y=89%–92.5%. Strictly no text, letters, numbers, words, logos, labels, watermarks, or signage anywhere.

elements.text: Don't be silly, everybody wants this.

why_it_works: Instant cultural recognition: preserves the iconic movie-poster composition, generous white negative space, and red stiletto pitchfork visual device while swapping the third-party jar for a rich dripping chocolate fudge cake.

Strong left-to-right visual balance: the tall crimson stiletto and ganache-dripping cake on the left counterweight the stacked Kapruka purple title lockup on the right without cluttering the white ground.

Clean brand consistency: unified Inter Bold typography in Kapruka Retail Purple (#340A5C) and lighter accent purple (#6B3FA0) preserves the reference's two-tone lockup hierarchy while keeping the Kapruka logo calm in the top-right safe margin.
changes: Replaced the third-party Lotus Biscoff jar with a tall round chocolate fudge cake overflowing with glossy ganache, while keeping the glossy crimson red stiletto and red three-pronged pitchfork device unchanged.

Rewrote the stacked parody lockup to THE / DEVIL / BUYS / KAPRUKA (matching exact 3/5/4/7 character counts) and adapted the bottom spoken punchline to 'Don't be silly, everybody wants this.' (37 chars, single line).
Switched all typography from Garamond and VAG Rounded to Inter Bold (weight 700) per the standing Inter-only rule.
Mapped text colours to Kapruka's palette on a light ground: primary headline words in Retail Purple #340A5C and accent words (THE, BUYS, bottom punchline) in legible lighter purple #6B3FA0.
Added the Kapruka logo on light ground in the calmest top-right corner (x=72%, y=7.5%, top edge 101px) within the 100px safe margin and 110px top-edge rule.

Moved the bottom punchline (e5) inside the 100px safe margins (x=9.5%–90.5%, y=89%–92.5%) and trimmed e4 width slightly to 44.5% so all text stays inside 100px–980px horizontally and 100px–1250px vertically.
Removed the devil-tail arrow ornament on the letter V per the no-ornaments rule.
claims_used: No factual, pricing, offer, or delivery claims are made in the copy; the ad relies purely on brand awareness for Kapruka (kapruka.com) as a gifting and e-commerce platform selling cakes, supported by 01-business-context.md Section 1 and 00-brand-guidelines.md Section 6.
